en.bilal-muhammad: My father (ra) narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. Ja`far al-Himyari narrated to us from Ibrahim b. Hashim from Muhammad b. Abi `Umayr from `Abd al-Rahman b. Siyaba. He said:

Abu `Abdillah al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as) gave me one thousand gold coins, and he ordered me to distribute it to the families who lost members with Zayd b. `Ali (as). So, I distributed it. I gave `Abdullah b. al-Zubayr the brother of Fudayl al-Rassan four gold coins.
